alerts.name: SQL Injection
alerts.desc: SQL injection may be possible. An attacker can manipulate backend database queries, allowing unauthorized data access, modification, or administrative command execution.

instances.evidence: syntax error near SELECT * FROM items WHERE query = 'test''

alerts.solution: Use parameterized queries (prepared statements) or Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) with proper escaping. Never concatenate untrusted user inputs directly into database queries.
alerts.otherinfo: The response contained raw database exception headers.

alerts.alert: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
alerts.name: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
alerts.desc: Content Security Policy (CSP) is an added layer of security that helps detect and mitigate certain types of attacks, including Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and data injection attacks.
alerts.solution: Ensure that your web server or reverse proxy is configured to return the Content-Security-Policy HTTP response header with strict directives such as default-src 'self'.

alerts.name: Anti-CSRF Tokens Check
alerts.desc: No Anti-CSRF tokens were found in a HTML submission form. An attacker could trick authenticated users into executing unwanted actions.
alerts.solution: Use unpredictable anti-CSRF tokens for all state-changing POST/PUT/DELETE requests, or use SameSite=Strict cookies with custom authentication headers.

alerts.name: Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set
alerts.desc: HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) header is missing. Without HSTS, connections might be downgraded from HTTPS to unencrypted HTTP by an on-path attacker.
alerts.solution: Configure the server to send Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload on all HTTPS responses.

alerts.name: Timestamp Disclosure - Unix
alerts.desc: A timestamp was disclosed by the application or web server in Unix epoch format.
alerts.solution: Manually verify whether this timestamp exposes internal server clock timings or build metadata that should remain confidential.
